survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note summarises system-level indicators for Peru using published Education at a Glance 2025 data tables rather than providing an analyzable student micro-dataset. As a result, there is no described application of student/sampling weights or replicate-weight procedures (e.g., BRR/jackknife) within this note. The figures and percentages are presented as indicator outputs from OECD’s underlying data collection and processing pipeline, which is documented separately in the Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes. For any re-analysis at the micro level, analysts should consult the corresponding indicator methodology documentation and use the weights provided in the underlying OECD datasets (if available), but this note itself does not specify weight variables.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a descriptive country note reporting indicator statistics (e.g., attainment shares, completion rates, expenditure per student) rather than an empirical student-level analysis that uses plausible values (PV) for cognitive achievement. Because no PV-based outcome modeling is conducted here, PV handling is not applicable. Similarly, the note does not report any missing-data strategy because it does not describe an original estimation procedure on a microdata sample; instead, it points to OECD tables and separate methodology documentation for indicator construction.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: This is a Peru country note that reports OECD Education at a Glance 2025 indicator values for the latest available reference year(s). The note does not describe an analytic subsample drawn from a student micro-dataset; it instead directs readers to the corresponding OECD tables (e.g., Table B5.1, Table C1.1, Table C1.2, Table D3.2) and to the separate Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes for indicator-specific data processing and coverage.

data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Peru country note) provides descriptive statistics about the education system, with emphasis on tertiary education, using OECD indicator tables for the latest available reference years. The note reports system-level outcomes such as attainment without upper secondary education among 25–34 year-olds, employment and earnings differentials by educational attainment, age-grade mismatch in lower secondary, bachelor’s completion within timeframes, field-of-study composition, dropout after the first year, and government expenditure per student by education level. It also summarises teacher-related indicators including relative teacher salaries and compulsory instruction time, plus the share of instruction time allocated to core subjects. No student-level modeling, plausible values, or missing-data handling strategy is described in this note; it is intended as an overview rather than an empirical ML study. For methodological details on how each indicator is constructed, the note points to the Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to an OECD descriptive country note rather than an empirical large-scale assessment analysis paper. Consequently, there is no student-level dataset, no ML model training/evaluation, no PV-based achievement outcome, and no reported analytic sample size or per-country microdata breakdown. The sparse fields (e.g., total_students, ML techniques, main findings) reflect the document’s purpose: summarising published indicators and directing readers to the underlying OECD tables and technical documentation for indicator construction and methodological choices.
